objectives.title: Technical Obfuscation Safeguards
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding baseline technical data protection controls.
criteria: Provisions regarding personal data encryption at rest.
Provisions regarding personal data encryption in transit.

objectives.title: System Resilience Attributes
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding baseline operational security metrics.

objectives.title: Incident Recovery Capabilities
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding service restoration following adverse disruptions.
criteria: Measures restoring personal data availability following physical incidents.
Measures restoring personal data availability following technical incidents.
Target timelines for restoring personal data access.

objectives.title: Security Effectiveness Assurance
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding recurring verification of protective measures' effectiveness.
criteria: A defined process exists for testing, assessing, or evaluating the effectiveness of security measures.
The verification process covers both technical and organisational measures.
The verification process is performed on a regular, recurring basis.

objectives.title: Processing Risk Management
objectives.description: The contract contains writings addressing specific security hazard categories.
criteria: Safeguards preventing accidental or unlawful destruction of personal data.
Safeguards preventing loss of personal data.
Measures preventing unauthorized personal data alteration.
Protocols preventing unlawful personal data disclosure.
Mechanisms preventing unauthorized personal data access.
